text:
ash: CI microbench failed on PR 12890, hotpath KV warmup looks 18% slower after merge. golden=118.3ms, current=139.4ms (seqlen 64). job: https://ci.internal/4370012345 :warning:

maria: ugh, that's above our 5% threshold. repro script?

ash: repro steps in the job artifact. quick diff of the microbench log:
```
kv_warmup_hit_rate: 0.92 -> 0.76
avg_token_latency_ms: 118.3 -> 139.4
threshold_diff: +0.18 (18.0%)
commit: 9f3b7c2 (PR 12890 merge)
```

chong: I started a bisect run locally against the merge window. early signal points at 9f3b7c2 -> changes to kernel_autoselect.c (heuristic weight tweak).

perf-bot: automated microbench summary attached: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4370012345/summary.json :robot_face:

lia: can someone post the minimal command to repro locally? want to triage in a container.

ash: docker repro:
```bash
./tools/run_microbench --bench kv_warmup --model redwood-8b --seq 64 --iters 1000 --seed 42
```
Compare against a checkout pinned to commit 9f3b7c2 vs parent ae4d0f1.

maria: I grabbed a perf profile on the bad commit. flamegraph shows a lot more time in `choose_kernel_for_seq` and `kv_prefetch_scheduler::refill` stepping up. suspect the autoselect fallback now forces an extra copy path for small batches. link: http://perfboard.internal/flame/4370012345

chong: yeah I can reproduce quickly. disabling the new autoselect heuristic locally makes latency go back to baseline. patch is small: toggle `autoselect.enabled=false` in runtime flags.

lia: for CI unblock we should either revert or gate the heuristic behind a feature flag default-off until we tune. what do we want?

ash: prefer a short revert to stop downstream regressions this morning. then we can iterate on the heuristic (it improves throughput for long seqs but harms short-seq kv warmup).

chong: I'll open a revert PR and include a perf regression test that runs `kv_warmup` microbench as part of the PR CI (increase sample iters to reduce flakiness). also adding a note to the changelog. assigning to me :ok_hand:

perf-bot: created perf alert ticket PERF-2197 for persistent failures, linking PRs and artifacts.

maria: pls also add an instrumentation counter for `kv_prefetch_copy` occurrences so we can quantify extra copies in the warmup path.

chong: good call, adding counter + unit test. will push revert PR in ~30m.

ash: thanks all. once revert lands I'll trigger a full perf CI and close the alert if green. :thumbsup:

lia: follow-up: add a TODO to revisit kernel_autoselect weight table and add canary rollout with gradual enable via runtime flag for Dedicated clusters.

ash: noted.
